review.reason: The cited passages support the AI-server PCB trend, the SI/PI test items, and the mapping of oscilloscopes to Interface Test and PDN blocks, while also noting missing specific scope specs. The only notable stretch is tying oscilloscopes specifically to waveform/eye-related validation; the sources list eye diagrams in the SI flow and scopes in interface testing, but do not explicitly state scopes perform eye validation.
